title: arachnorchis aestiva
intro: Arachnorchis aestiva, commonly known as the Sun Moth Orchid, is a rare and endemic orchid species native to Western Australia. This plant is prized for its vibrant yellow and green flowers and has been used in traditional Aboriginal medicine for its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Arachnorchis aestiva include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Arachnorchis aestiva include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
